defs.def: either of the two round soft parts at the front of a woman's body that produce milk when she has had a baby （女子的）乳房
the similar, smaller part on a man's body, which does not produce milk （男子的）退化乳房
the top part of the front of your body, below your neck 胸部；胸脯

ex.s: I held my certificate against my breast and smiled at the camera.
ex.t: 我把证书贴在胸前，对着相机微笑。

defs.def: the part of a piece of clothing that covers your chest 前胸部分
the front part of a bird's body （鸟的）胸部
meat from the front part of the body of a bird or an animal （鸟或动物的）胸脯肉

ex.s: We saw what we thought was a doe fording the torrent, her breast awash in white water.
ex.t: 我们看见一只我们以为是母鹿的动物正涉过急流，胸脯没在白色的水中。

defs.def: having the type of chest or breasts mentioned 构成形容词
the part of the body where the feelings and emotions are thought to be 心窝；情感
to reach the top of a hill, etc. 登上 … 的顶部
to push through sth, touching it with your chest 挺胸从 … 中挤过

chunks.cn: 反对 我的 乳房
证明 反对 我的 乳房
